title: Ahead and Back
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：ahead　|　正文 306 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ahead 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Ahead, in 1987 the observer pushed the lens at the dome, and everybody in the observatory said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning: the observer had pushed the lens ② ahead in public, and nobody had asked a single question. The observer had come to the observatory two nights earlier, and spoke little of the observatory he had left behind him.

The log for November 1981 puts it plainer. The lens was ③ ahead, and the assistant who kept it wrote of the lens ④ ahead in the same line; nothing in the observatory was ever left ahead for long in those days. The assistant wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every night thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the lens at the far dome, meant something else. He had come from ⑤ ahead, and ⑥ Ahead came the assistant who was to carry it back; he was not a man who explained himself, and the observatory had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1994 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the log. What the line asked for was that the lens be noted ⑦ ahead at the dome, and that everybody be ⑧ ahead before the November rains. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried ahead.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1997 she pushed the lens  ahead in silence when nobody else would, and  Ahead, she said in 1999, that was the part the observatory never forgot; the log still speaks of it ahead. She kept the lens in the same dome for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the observatory never forgot how ahead it had all been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 在前面（句末状语，置于宾语之后：pushed the lens ahead，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 在前面（作表语，说明处所或去向：the lens was ahead）
C. adv. 向前（置于句首：Ahead, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 向前（作后置定语，紧跟被修饰的名词：the lens ahead）
E. adv. 向前（作介词宾语：from ahead）
F. adv. 向前（句首强调，引起全部倒装：Ahead came the assistant）
G. adv. 在前面（被动结构中置于过去分词之后：be noted ahead at the dome）
H. adv. 在前面（be ahead 说明所在或去向：everybody be ahead before the rains）

answers.why: ahead 意为“向前”，此处置于句首交代地点或去向：Ahead, in 1987 …。
ahead 意为“在前面”，此处置于宾语之后作状语：had pushed the lens ahead。
ahead 意为“在前面”，此处作表语说明那件小小的镜片的去向或所在：was ahead。
ahead 意为“向前”，此处作后置定语紧跟名词：the lens ahead。
ahead 意为“向前”，此处作介词 from 的宾语：from ahead。
ahead 意为“向前”，此处置于句首引起全部倒装：Ahead came the assistant。
ahead 意为“在前面”，被动结构中副词置于过去分词之后：be noted ahead at the dome。
ahead 意为“在前面”，be ahead 说明众人须在雨季前到达某处或处于某状态。
